newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Colombia Jan coffee exports may fall 300,000 bags.
newsitem.headline: Colombia Jan coffee exports may fall 300,000 bags.

text.p: Colombian exports of coffee in January may be 300,000 bags less than anticipated if a continuing strike at port of Buenaventura continues, said the head of Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation.

"We were expecting to ship around one million bags in January...because of the strike it could be 300,000 bags less although if the problem was resolved today it may be less than that," Jorge Cardenas told Reuters while attending an international coffee seminar.
Early Wednesday, talks aimed at ending a week-old dockworkers' strike in the Pacific port ended in deadlock. The port ships about 60 percent of Colombia's coffee exports and all its sugar exports.
Cardenas estimated that around 400,000 bags of coffee may currently be affected by the strike.
"I think there may be around 200,000 bags held up at the port and another 200,000 bags on the way to the port," he said.
